name: Signet of Unyielding Strength
label: Quest
description: Signet of Unyielding Strength: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The rings worn by the Qiraji lieutenants are rumored to grant them formidable abilities. The corrupted gems that adorn them could, in theory, be swapped out with more pure materials to create uncorrupted versions of the rings.
The gems that adorn Qiraji idols would work quite well, as their quality is superior.
Bring me the ring and idols and I'll create a powerful ring for you, adventurer.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you bring me the ring and materials, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I will swap the gem on the ring for you. You'll find the effect is much more... Agreeable.
